//: Copy to claudefuscator.local.json (gitignored) and edit. This file holds REAL
identifier values in plaintext, which is why the real one is never
committed. The KEY does not belong in here - it goes in the plugin's
/config prompt (OS credential store) or the CLAUDEFUSCATOR_KEY env var.
The Chrome extension needs the SAME identifiers list, because tokens are
one-way HMACs: the extension restores a token by recomputing the HMAC over
the values it knows. Paste this file's contents into the extension options
page. Anything NOT in this list can still be tokenized by a pattern, but
the extension cannot restore it - only the terminal side can.
//projects: Where Claudefuscator is allowed to act. A list of directory paths; the
session must be inside one of them or the mod/plugin loads INACTIVE and
says so. Absent or empty means every project.
This lives in the config rather than in per-project settings because a
mod can be loaded globally (CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS, or installing it),
and config hygiene slips. Gating here means that even when it IS loaded
everywhere, it only acts where you said.
A path matches itself and anything inside it. `~/git/acme` does NOT match
Not applied to the proxy, which you start explicitly per session.
//promptPolicy: warn = a typed identifier IS sent, you just get told. block = prompt rejected before the model sees it.
//onError: block = a tool result we failed to scrub is withheld from the model (fail closed). passthrough = sent unscrubbed.
//restoreToolInput: Rewrites tokens back to real values in tool ARGUMENTS so local tools work. See TESTING.md check 4 before trusting it.
//cacheDiscovered: Persists pattern-matched values (IPs, MACs) so they can be restored in the terminal. WRITES REAL VALUES TO DISK IN PLAINTEXT. Off by default.
//packs: Reusable vocabulary layers, applied BEFORE the identifiers below so your
project list can override them. Real packs go in config/packs/*.local.json
(gitignored); tools/harvest-vocab.js can propose one from your repos
without ever printing the terms. See config/packs/example-org.json.
//allowList: Never tokenize these, whatever matched them - the safety valve for an
over-eager personal filter. Wins over patterns AND identifiers.
Paste in config/allowlist-nl-en.json's list, or reference it as a pack.
//internalDomains: Any hostname ending in one of these is tokenized automatically.
//patterns: Built-in high-precision matchers. No person-name detection by design - names go in identifiers below.
//identifiers: type is a free label and becomes the token prefix.
aliases normally collapse onto the SAME token as value, so restore emits
value rather than the alias - value-preserving, not byte-preserving.
caseSensitive: match only this exact casing, and give each spelling its
own token. Use for short acronyms so the lowercase word is left alone.
compound: also match INSIDE code identifiers (Acme -> AcmeClient).
Implies caseSensitive and per-spelling tokens, so code round-trips
byte-exact instead of being case-folded into a different symbol. List
every spelling you want hit; unlisted ones are left alone.
This renames a LABEL in code - it does not hide what the code does.

identifiers.//: Short acronym: exact case only, or every lowercase use gets hit.
Company name that also appears inside C#/TS symbol names.
